root_cause.text: The `hbh_mt6_check()` function failed to validate that the user-supplied `optsnr` field does not exceed the fixed array size `IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR` (16) before installing the rule, allowing out-of-bounds array access when the packet matching path indexes into the fixed-size `opts[IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR]` array.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a bounds check `if (optsinfo->optsnr > IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR)` in the rule setup path (`hbh_mt6_check()`), and the UBSAN error shows "index 16 is out of range for type '__u16 [16]'" at line 110 in ip6t_hbh.c, confirming that userspace could supply an `optsnr` value of 16 or greater, causing an off-by-one array access on the fixed-size `opts` array during packet matching.
